这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的图像到视频工作流程，适用于具有多个 LORA 的单个 WAN 2.1 GGUF 模型的单个输入图像（此工作流程确实需要 ComfyUI 的 LORA Manager 插件才能运行。最好安装 ComfyUI 管理器和 LORA Manager 插件，以帮助您轻松下载和管理检查点、LORA 和其他资源。这两个不仅对此工作流程有帮助，而且在任何其他方面都会为您提供帮助例）。您需要一个 Hugging Face 帐户来下载必要的 WAN 2.1 文件（详细信息如下所述）。确保使用 ComfyUI 管理器为 ComfyUI 安装 GGUF 插件，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、HiDream 和 通量。

如何使用这个 -

#1.首先选择用于图像到视频生成的输入图像，然后

#2.只需首先选择您想要的 WAN 2.1 GGUF 模型，然后再加载

＃3。从 LORA Manager 启动一个或多个匹配的 LORA

＃4。然后输入你的正面和负面提示。

＃5。选择您想要的视频数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃6。选择视频分辨率、CFG、步数等设置

#7.最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

*** 如果您知道如何正确禁用 LORA 节点并绕过它，此工作流程也将起作用。此外，经过一些修改，这将适用于 WAN 2.2 5b 和 WAN 2.2（高+低噪声）GGUF 型号

享受吧！

### 要使用此工作流程，您需要登录 Huggingface 并从那里下载必要的文件（我还在包含工作流程文件的存档中包含了一个文本文件，您可以在其中找到更多关于我的其他工作流程的基本下载的链接）-

这些是此工作流程支持的标准/本机宽高比，已针对最佳性能和质量进行了优化（请注意，并非所有 GPU 都可以及时处理 720p 到 4K 视频）：

240p：通常约为 320x240 像素（4:3 宽高比）或 426x240 像素（16:9 宽高比，但真正的 240p 不太常见）。一些较旧的控制台输出略有不同的变化，例如 256x224 或 320x224。

360p：最常见的 640x360 像素（16:9 宽高比）。一些较旧的内容或 4:3 内容可能是 480x360。

480p：最常见的是 854x480 像素（16:9 宽高比）或 640x480 像素（4:3 宽高比）。

720p（高清）：1280x720 像素（16:9 宽高比）。

1080p（全高清/全高清）：1920x1080 像素（16:9 宽高比）。

o.en:
This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly Image-to-Video workflow that will work for a single input image with a single WAN 2.1 GGUF model with multiple LORAs (This workflow does require ComfyUI's LORA Manager plugin to function. It is a good idea to install both ComfyUI manager and LORA Manager plugin to help you easily download and manage Checkpoints, LORAs and other resources. Not only these two are helpful for this workflow but they will help you a lot in any other cases). You need a Hugging Face account to download your necessary WAN 2.1 files (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you install GGUF addon for ComfyUI using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, HiDream and Flux.

How to use this -

#1. First select your input image for Image-to-Video generation, then

#2. just select your desired WAN 2.1 GGUF model first and after this load

#3. one or multiple matching LORA(s) from LORA Manager to start

#4. then input your positive and negative prompts.

#5. select how many videos you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#6. select video resolution, CFG, steps etc. settings

#7. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

*** This workflow will also function if you know how to properly disable the LORA Node and bypass it. Also with some modifications this will work with WAN 2.2 5b and WAN 2.2 (High+Low Noise) GGUF models

Enjoy!

### To use this workflow you need to log into huggingface and download necessary files from there (I also included a text file on the archive that has the workflow file, in which you will find even more links for essential downloads for my other workflows) -

These are standard / native aspect ratios supported by this workflow that are optimized for best performance and quality (note not all GPUs can process 720p to 4K videos in timely manner) :

240p: Often around 320x240 pixels (4:3 aspect ratio) or 426x240 pixels (16:9 aspect ratio, though less common for true 240p). Some older consoles output slightly different variations, e.g., 256x224 or 320x224.

360p: Most commonly 640x360 pixels (16:9 aspect ratio). Some older or 4:3 content might be 480x360.

480p: Most commonly 854x480 pixels (16:9 aspect ratio) or 640x480 pixels (4:3 aspect ratio).

720p (HD): 1280x720 pixels (16:9 aspect ratio).

1080p (Full HD/FHD): 1920x1080 pixels (16:9 aspect ratio).
